content: {"decision":"Reject reliability and savings claims; block deployment pending cross-tenant leak remediation and validation.","risks":["23/26 is 88.5% after two correction rounds, not 87% first-pass reliability; first-pass results are unknown.","Hand-picked easy tasks and 12 prompt-example tasks bias results and do not establish generalization.","A cross-tenant leak is a critical failure, not a valid pass.","The 95% confidence claim lacks a defined interval and defensible sampling basis.","80% savings is unsupported because reviewer tokens and retries are excluded."],"required_changes":["Reclassify the leaking pass as a failure and report security failures separately.","Fix tenant isolation and validate it with adversarial regression tests.","Evaluate a representative, unseen holdout with predefined scoring; report first-pass and corrected outcomes separately.","Report uncertainty using a justified sampling design and sufficient sample size.","Recalculate savings against a comparable baseline, including all attempts, reviewer tokens, human review time, and remediation."],"evidence_needed":["Per-task first-attempt results, correction history, scoring criteria, and prompt-example overlap.","Leak root-cause analysis, fix evidence, and independent tenant-isolation test results.","Holdout sampling protocol, sample-size rationale, and confidence-interval calculation.","Complete token, retry, labor, and cost records for both model workflow and baseline at comparable quality."]}
